newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: CRICKET-RAIN AGAIN HITS NZ-SRI LANKA ONE-DAYER.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-RAIN AGAIN HITS NZ-SRI LANKA ONE-DAYER.

text.p: Rain delayed the start of play in the one-day international between Sri Lanka and New Zealand at Eden Park on Sunday.
The match, the first of the scheduled three-game series, was originally scheduled for Saturday but was postponed because of heavy rain.
The provisional start time is now 11.00 a.m. (2300 GMT) but commentators said it appeared unlikely play would get underway by then.
